set.pl: Jacobson land at the shared corner of sec 32 T136N R41W (Dora Twp) and sec 4 T135N R41W, south of Silent Lake
set.t: 1888 homestead NW¼ sec 4 T135N R41W; 1933 land SE¼ sec 32 T136N R41W; farmstead site unknown. The killers wrecked the house in 1932, so search the outbuilding sites, fence lines and garden. C, not B: the money is only "reputed" and the killers may have found it. Private land: permission needed.
pinev: Pin at the shared section corner, r 900 m, covering the 1933 SE¼ sec 32 land and the 1888 NW¼ sec 4 homestead
Farmstead not shown on the 1933 plat or the 1939 aerial
